setup: The ASOScan plugin or connector is connected (ChatGPT, Claude or Claude Code) and ASOSCAN_API_KEY is NOT set. At least one app in the ASOScan account.
expected_behavior: Calls list_my_apps, then find_keyword_opportunities, and never asks for an API key or runs curl
Reads the opportunities from the tool result (a list arrives inside items) and ranks them by opportunityScore
Asks before calling research_keyword and states its cost of 8 API credits
Asks before calling track_keywords and only tracks the terms the user picked
Presents volume and difficulty as plain numbers and promises no rank
